effects.description: The recipient cannot move or attack, and Passive Skills are disabled.Active Skill cooldowns continue to count down as normal.The recipient will continue to take 100% damage from incoming attacks.

Casts a [Stun] debuff on the targets, lasting 1s. Stunned targets cannot move or use Skills, take 100% damage as normal, and their Skill Cooldowns will behave as normal.

bio: Rilven's tracking skills are in high demand among Deepcast miners. Having spent most of her childhood scrabbling through dark tunnels, she's got an eye for finding passages that'll lead to a pay-day. With her luxgem arrows to light the way, your expedition's in safe hands with Rilven.
